description: Governor's Office - North Western Province - Enlarge the Commission of Inquiry
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the extension of an investigation period for a commission looking into potential offences by a municipal mayor. The content involves judicial/law enforcement matters, specifically the investigation of alleged misconduct by a local government official under the Municipal Councils Ordinance. It references a retired Judicial Officer conducting the investigation and deals with legal procedures and timelines for submitting investigative reports, falling clearly within the Judicial/Law Enforcement category (Type 9).
